implemented: Deterministic pure Dart evaluator with injected input/policy and canonical JSON results; obsolete marker file removed.
Conservative floor/ceil arrival intervals, strict possible/ unlikely boundaries, stopped-speed and stop-line uncertainty handling.
Missing or unapproved policy, stale/unverified signals and malformed sensor inputs fail closed with canonical reason priority.
Monotonic deadlines deduct source age once, expire at strict TTL/phase boundaries, retain high-water time on rollback, and cannot be reset by duplicate or unproven-order source events.
Synthetic policy is explicitly separate and cannot authorize ordinary operational input.

verification.tests: flutter test: all 85 mobile tests passed, including prediction, deadlines, matching, real socket transport and session integration
scenarios: TTL equality, expired source age, rollback, duplicate and unverified newer events cannot revive stale signal timing
Zero speed, nonfinite input, stop-line overlap, missing policy and unverified timing do not produce possible
An already four-second-old location expires after the remaining source-age budget, not five seconds after receipt; fresh signal data cannot keep its prediction alive.
Speed, target and road distance are committed atomically. A stop update cannot notify listeners with the previous optimistic result and the new distance.

productionBoundary: Engine verification does not approve live provider timing, geometry or operational policy. Ordinary mobile driving currently withholds countdown/predictions because these external evidence gates are unmet.
